description_en: Queries the details of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的详细信息
name: DescribeDBInstanceAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID.
<warning>Do not specify multiple instance IDs for batch queries. Otherwise, the query times out and fails.></warning>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。可调用DescribeDBInstances获取。
<warning>请勿同时配置多个实例ID进行批量查询，否则将会查询超时导致失败。></warning>
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The expiration status of the instance. Valid values:

True: The instance has expired.
False: The instance has not expired
parameters.help_zh:
实例过期状态。取值：

True：已过期。
False：未过期
parameters.name: expired

AccountMaxQuantity.description_en: The maximum number of accounts that can be created on the instance
AccountMaxQuantity.description_zh: 可创建账号的最大数量

AdvancedFeatures.description_en:
The advanced features of the instance. This parameter is applicable only to SQL Server instances. Multiple values are separated by commas (,). Valid values:
LinkedServer: linked server.
DistributeTransaction: distributed transaction
AdvancedFeatures.description_zh:
目前只针对SQL Server，获取高级特性值，多个值之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。返回值：
LinkedServer：链接服务器。
DistributeTransaction：分布式事务

AutoUpgradeMinorVersion.description_en:
The method used to upgrade the minor engine version of the instance. Valid values:
Auto: The minor engine version is automatically upgraded.
Manual: The minor engine version is not automatically upgraded. The minor engine version is forcefully upgraded only when the current version is taken offline
AutoUpgradeMinorVersion.description_zh:
实例升级小版本的方式。返回值：
Auto：自动升级小版本。
Manual：不自动升级，仅在当前版本下线时才强制升级

AvailabilityValue.description_en: The availability status of the instance, in percentage (%)
AvailabilityValue.description_zh: 实例可用性状态，单位：百分比（%）

BabelfishConfig.description_en: The configuration information of [Babelfish for RDS PostgreSQL]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428613.html）

BabelfishEnabled.description_en:
The Babelfish switch.
If Babelfish is enabled when you purchase an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance, this parameter is fixed to true
BabelfishEnabled.description_zh:
Babelfish开关。
购买RDS PostgreSQL实例时，如果开启了Babelfish，则此参数固定为true

MigrationMode.description_en:
The Babelfish [migration mode]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428613.html）. Valid values:
single-db: single-database mode.
multi-db: multi-database mode
MigrationMode.description_zh:
Babelfish[迁移模式]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428613.html）。返回值：
single-db：单数据库模式。
multi-db：多数据库模式

BlueGreenDeploymentName.description_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter

BlueInstanceName.description_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter

BurstingEnabled.description_en:
The I/O performance burst feature switch for [Premium ESSD]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2340501.html）. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
BurstingEnabled.description_zh:
[高性能云盘]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2340501.html）的IO性能突发功能开关。取值：
true：开启。
false：关闭

CanTempUpgrade.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance meets the conditions for a temporary upgrade.
Pay-as-you-go instances do not support temporary upgrades
CanTempUpgrade.description_zh:
是否满足临时升级条件。
按量付费实例不支持临时升级

Category.description_en:
The instance edition. Valid values:
Basic: Basic Edition
HighAvailability: High-availability Edition
cluster: MySQL Cluster Edition
AlwaysOn: SQL Server Cluster Edition
Finance: RDS Enterprise Edition
Serverless_basic: Serverless Basic Edition
Category.description_zh:
实例系列。返回值：
Basic：基础系列
HighAvailability：高可用系列
cluster：MySQL集群系列
AlwaysOn：SQL Server集群系列
Finance：三节点企业系列
Serverless_basic：Serverless基础系列

ColdDataEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the [cold data archiving]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2701832.html） feature for premium performance disks is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
ColdDataEnabled.description_zh:
高性能云盘[数据归档]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2701832.html）功能开关。返回值：

true：开启。
false：关闭

Collation.description_en: The character set collation of the instance

ComputeBurstEnabled.description_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter

ConnectionMode.description_en:
The access mode of the instance. Valid values:
Standard: standard access mode.
Safe: database proxy mode
ConnectionMode.description_zh:
实例的访问模式。返回值：
Standard：标准访问模式。
Safe：数据库代理模式

ConsoleVersion.description_en:
The proxy type of the instance. Valid values:
1: shared database proxy.
2: dedicated database proxy.

We recommend that you do not use this parameter. Use the response parameter ProxyType instead
ConsoleVersion.description_zh:
实例的代理类型。返回值：
1：共享代理。
2：独享代理。

不建议使用该参数，请使用返回参数ProxyType

CreationTime.description_en: The creation time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

ClassType.description_en:
The node specifications type. Valid values:
d: dedicated specification
x: general-purpose specification
ClassType.description_zh:
节点规格类型。返回值：
d：独享规格
x：通用规格

Cpu.description_en: The number of CPUs of the node

Memory.description_en: The memory size of the node. Unit: MB

NodeRole.description_en:
The node role. Valid values:

primary: primary node
secondary: secondary node
NodeRole.description_zh:
节点角色。返回值：

primary：主节点
secondary：备节点

Status.description_en:
The status of the node. Valid values:
active
creating
deleting
classchanging
restarting
Status.description_zh:
节点的状态。返回值：
active
creating
deleting
classchanging
restarting

DBInstanceCPU.description_en: The number of CPUs of the instance

DBInstanceClass.description_en: The instance type. For more information, see [Instance types]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html）
DBInstanceClass.description_zh: 实例规格，详情请参见[实例规格表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html）

DBInstanceClassType.description_en:
The instance family. Valid values:

s: shared instance type.
x: general-purpose instance type.
d: dedicated instance type.
h: dedicated host
DBInstanceClassType.description_zh:
实例规格族。返回值：

s：共享型。
x：通用型。
d：独享套餐。
h：独占物理机

DBInstanceDiskUsed.description_en:
The disk usage of the instance. Unit: bytes.

<notice>For ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL serverless instances, if the instance status is Stopped, the value of this parameter is 0.></notice>
DBInstanceDiskUsed.description_zh:
实例的磁盘使用量，单位：byte。

<notice>对于RDS MySQL Serverless实例，当实例状态为已暂停（Stopped）时，该参数返回值为0。></notice>

DBInstanceMemory.description_en: The memory of the instance. Unit: MB

DBInstanceNetType.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is connected over the Internet or an internal network. Valid values:

Internet: Internet.
Intranet: internal network
DBInstanceNetType.description_zh:
实例是内网或外网。返回值：

Internet：外网。
Intranet：内网

DBInstanceStatus.description_en: The instance status. For more information, see [Instance states]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26315.html）
DBInstanceStatus.description_zh: 实例状态，详情请参见[实例状态表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26315.html）

DBInstanceStorage.description_en: The instance storage space. Unit: GB

DBInstanceStorageType.description_en:
The storage type of the instance. Valid values:

local_ssd or ephemeral_ssd: local SSD.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
general_essd: Premium ESSD.
cloud_essd0: PL0 ESSD.
cloud_essd: PL1 ESSD.
cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD.
cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD
DBInstanceStorageType.description_zh:
实例储存类型。返回值：

local_ssd、ephemeral_ssd：高性能本地盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。
general_essd：高性能云盘。
cloud_essd0：ESSD PL0云盘。
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘。
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘。
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘

DBInstanceType.description_en:
The instance type. Valid values:

Primary: primary instance.
Readonly: read-only instance.
Guard: disaster recovery instance.
Temp: temporary instance
DBInstanceType.description_zh:
实例类型。返回值：

Primary：主实例。
Readonly：只读实例。
Guard：灾备实例。
Temp：临时实例

DBMaxQuantity.description_en: The maximum number of databases that can be created on the instance
DBMaxQuantity.description_zh: 一个实例下可创建最大数据库数量

DeletionProtection.description_en:
Indicates whether the release protection feature is enabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
DeletionProtection.description_zh:
是否已开启释放保护功能。返回值：
true：已开启。
false：未开启

DisasterRecoveryInfo.description_en: The information about the source instance for disaster recovery

DisasterRecoveryInstances.description_en: All disaster recovery instances attached to the current instance
DisasterRecoveryInstances.description_zh: 当前实例的所有灾备实例

Engine.description_en:
The database engine type. Valid values:

MySQL
PostgreSQL
SQLServer
MariaDB
Engine.description_zh:
数据库类型。返回值：

MySQL
PostgreSQL
SQLServer
MariaDB

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC. Pay-as-you-go instances do not have an expiration time
ExpireTime.description_zh: 到期时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 按量付费实例无到期时间

AccountSecurityPolicy.description_en:
The password policy for database accounts. Valid values:
MaximumPasswordAge: the maximum password age
MinimumPasswordAge: the minimum password age
AccountSecurityPolicy.description_zh:
数据库账号的密码策略。返回值：
MaximumPasswordAge：密码的最长使用时间
MinimumPasswordAge：密码的最短使用时间

DBInstanceId.description_en: The list of database instance IDs

RecoveryModel.example:
Simple：简单恢复模式。
Full：完整恢复模式。

GeneralGroupName.description_en: The name of the group to which the dedicated cluster MySQL general-purpose instance belongs
GeneralGroupName.description_zh: 专属集群MySQL通用版实例所属的组名

GreenInstanceName.description_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter

GuardDBInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the disaster recovery instance that is attached to the instance
GuardDBInstanceId.description_zh: 该实例如果挂载着灾备实例，即为灾备实例的ID

IPType.description_en: The IP address type. Currently, only IPv4 is supported

IncrementSourceDBInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID from which incremental data originates. For example, the incremental data of a disaster recovery instance originates from the primary instance. The incremental data of a read-only instance originates from the primary instance. If this parameter is not returned, the instance is a primary instance
IncrementSourceDBInstanceId.description_zh: 增量数据来源的实例ID，例如灾备实例的增量数据来源是主实例。只读实例的增量数据来源是主实例，如果没有返回此参数则表示该实例是主实例

InstanceNetworkType.description_en:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:
Classic: classic network.
VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC)
InstanceNetworkType.description_zh:
实例的网络类型。返回值：
Classic：经典网络。
VPC：专有网络

InstructionSetArch.description_en:
The architecture type of the instance. Valid values:

x86
arm
InstructionSetArch.description_zh:
实例的架构类型。返回值：

x86
arm

IoAccelerationEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the [Buffer Pool Extension (BPE)]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527067.html） feature for premium performance disks is enabled. Valid values:

1: enabled
0: disabled
IoAccelerationEnabled.description_zh:
高性能云盘的[Buffer Pool Extension（BPE）]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2527067.html）功能开关。返回值：

1：开启
0：不开启

IsAnalyticReadOnlyIns.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is a [MySQL DuckDB-based analytical instance]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2950002.html）. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No
IsAnalyticReadOnlyIns.description_zh:
实例是否属于[MySQL DuckDB分析实例]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2950002.html）。返回值：

true：是
false：否

LatestKernelVersion.description_en: The latest minor engine version supported by the instance
LatestKernelVersion.description_zh: 当前实例支持的最新内核版本

LockMode.description_en:
The lock mode of the instance. Valid values:
Unlock: Normal.
ManualLock: manually locked.
LockByExpiration: automatically locked upon instance expiration.
LockByRestoration: automatically locked before instance rollback.
LockByDiskQuota: automatically locked when the instance storage is full.
LockReadInstanceByDiskQuota: automatically locked when the read-only instance storage is full
LockMode.description_zh:
实例锁定模式。返回值：
Unlock：正常。
ManualLock：手动触发锁定。
LockByExpiration：实例过期自动锁定。
LockByRestoration：实例回滚前的自动锁定。
LockByDiskQuota：实例空间满自动锁定。
LockReadInstanceByDiskQuota：只读实例空间满自动锁定

LockReason.description_en: The reason why the instance is locked

MaintainTime.description_en: The maintenance window of the instance. The time is displayed in UTC. Add 8 hours to convert the time to the maintenance window displayed in the console
MaintainTime.description_zh: 实例可维护时间段，表示为UTC时间，+8小时后是控制台上显示到的可维护时间段

MasterInstanceId.description_en:
The ID of the primary instance.

If this parameter is not returned, the instance is a primary instance
MasterInstanceId.description_zh:
主实例的ID。

如果没有返回此参数则表示该实例是主实例

MasterZone.description_en: The ID of the primary zone

MaxConnections.description_en: The maximum number of concurrent connections

MaxIOMBPS.description_en: The maximum I/O throughput. Unit: MB/s

MaxIOPS.description_en: The maximum number of I/O requests per second

MultipleTempUpgrade.description_en: Indicates whether the instance is undergoing an elastic specification change. A return value of true indicates that an elastic specification change is in progress. If no elastic specification change is in progress, this parameter is not returned
MultipleTempUpgrade.description_zh: 实例是否正在进行弹性变配。返回true表示当前正在进行弹性变配，若未进行，则不返回该参数值

OptimizedWritesInfo.description_en:
OptimizedWritesInfo contains two fields:

optimized_writes: indicates whether 16KB atomic write is enabled for the current instance.

init_optimized_writes: indicates whether the instance can enable 16KB atomic write. Some instances are not displayed with the 16KB atomic write toggle in the console because init_optimized_writes is set to false
OptimizedWritesInfo.description_zh:
OptimizedWritesInfo包含两个字段：

optimized_writes：当前实例是否开启了16K原子写。

init_optimized_writes：实例能否开启16K原子写。部分实例因为init_optimized_writes为false不在控制台展示16K原子写开关

PGBouncerEnabled.description_en:
The PgBouncer switch.
This parameter is returned only for PostgreSQL instances. If PgBouncer is enabled, the value of this parameter is true
PGBouncerEnabled.description_zh:
PgBouncer开关。
仅PostgreSQL实例返回此参数，如果开启了PgBouncer，则此参数返回值为true

PayType.description_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription.
SERVERLESS: serverless
PayType.description_zh:
实例付费方式。返回值：

Postpaid：按量付费。
Prepaid：包年包月。
SERVERLESS：Serverless

ProxyType.description_en:
The proxy type supported by the instance. Valid values:

0: The database proxy feature is not supported.
1: The shared database proxy (multi-tenant mode) is supported.
2: The dedicated database proxy (single-tenant mode) is supported
ProxyType.description_zh:
实例支持的代理类型。返回值：

0：不支持开通代理。
1：支持开通共享代理（多租户模式）。
2：支持开通独享代理（单租户模式）

ReadOnlyDBInstanceId.description_en: The list of read-only instance IDs attached to the primary instance
ReadOnlyDBInstanceId.description_zh: 主实例下挂载的只读实例ID列表

items.description_en: The details of the read-only instance

ReadOnlyStatus.description_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter

ReadonlyInstanceSQLDelayedTime.description_en: The delayed replication time of the read-only instance. The read-only instance synchronizes data from the primary instance after a delay of ReadonlyInstanceSQLDelayedTime. Unit: seconds
ReadonlyInstanceSQLDelayedTime.description_zh: 只读实例延迟复制时间，只读实例延迟ReadonlyInstanceSQLDelayedTime的时间后再同步主实例数据，单位：秒（s）

SecurityIPList.description_en: The list of IP addresses in the IP whitelist group

SecurityIPMode.description_en:
The whitelist mode. Valid values:
normal: standard mode.
safety: enhanced whitelist
SecurityIPMode.description_zh:
白名单模式。返回值：
normal：通用模式。
safety：高安全模式

ServerlessConfig.description_en: The settings of the serverless ApsaraDB RDS instance

AutoPause.description_en:
Indicates whether the automatic start and stop feature is enabled for the serverless instance. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled. This is the default value.

If no connections are established within 10 minutes, the instance enters the paused state. The instance automatically wakes up when a connection is established
AutoPause.description_zh:
是否开启Serverless实例的自动启停功能。返回值：

true：启用。
false：不启用，默认值。

10分钟无任何连接将进入暂停状态，连接时会自动唤醒

ScaleMax.description_en: The maximum value of the automatic scaling range for the instance RDS Capacity Unit (RCU)
ScaleMax.description_zh: 实例RCU（RDS Capacity Unit）自动扩缩范围的最大值

ScaleMin.description_en: The minimum value of the automatic scaling range for the instance RDS Capacity Unit (RCU)
ScaleMin.description_zh: 实例RCU（RDS Capacity Unit）自动扩缩范围的最小值

SwitchForce.description_en:
Indicates whether forced scaling is enabled for the serverless instance. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled. This is the default value.

Elastic scaling of instance RCUs usually takes effect immediately. However, in some special cases, scaling cannot be completed instantly. In this case, you can enable this parameter to force scaling
SwitchForce.description_zh:
是否开启Serverless实例的强制弹性扩缩容。返回值：

true：启用。
false：不启用，默认值。

实例RCU的弹性扩缩容通常会立刻生效，但在某些特殊情况下无法即时完成扩缩容，此时可开启本参数进行强制扩缩容

SlaveZone.description_en: The list of parameters that make up SlaveZones

SuperPermissionMode.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance supports enabling high-privilege features such as the SA account, AD domain, and host account. Valid values:
Enable: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled
SuperPermissionMode.description_zh:
当前实例是否可以开放SA账号、AD域、主机账号等高权限功能。返回值：
Enable：开放。
Disabled：不开放

SupportCompression.description_en: Indicates whether the instance supports enabling storage compression
SupportCompression.description_zh: 实例是否支持开启存储压缩

TempDBInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the temporary instance if one is mounted to this instance
TempDBInstanceId.description_zh: 该实例如果挂载着临时实例，即为临时实例ID

TempUpgradeTimeEnd.description_en:
The end time of the temporary upgrade for the instance.

Pay-as-you-go instances do not have a temporary upgrade end time
TempUpgradeTimeEnd.description_zh:
实例临时升级结束时间。

按量付费实例无实例临时升级结束时间

TempUpgradeTimeStart.description_en:
The start time of the temporary upgrade for the instance.

Pay-as-you-go instances do not have a temporary upgrade start time
TempUpgradeTimeStart.description_zh:
实例临时升级开始时间。

按量付费实例无实例临时升级开始时间

Tips.description_en: The exception information of the dedicated cluster MySQL general-purpose instance
Tips.description_zh: 专属集群MySQL通用版实例的异常提示信息

TipsLevel.description_en:
The exception level of the dedicated cluster MySQL general-purpose instance. Valid values:
1: Normal.
2: The specifications of the read-only instance and the primary instance are not aligned, which may affect availability. Adjust the instance specifications as needed
TipsLevel.description_zh:
专属集群MySQL通用版实例的异常提示等级。返回值：
1：正常。
2：只读实例和主实例规格不对齐，可能影响可用性，请按需调整实例规格

kindCode.description_en: An internal parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter
